tasks.label: Tizen: Build & Install on TV
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; PROJECT="${workspaceFolder}"; set -a; source "$PROJECT/.env"; set +a; BUILD="$PROJECT/$BUILD_DIR"; echo '=== Clean ==='; rm -rf "$BUILD"; echo '=== Build ==='; "$TIZEN" build-web -- "$PROJECT"; echo '=== Package & sign ==='; "$TIZEN" package -t wgt -s "$PROFILE" -- "$BUILD"; WGT="$(find "$BUILD" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.wgt' -print -quit)"; if [ -z "$WGT" ]; then echo 'ERROR: WGT not found'; exit 1; fi; echo "WGT: $WGT"; echo '=== Install ==='; "$TIZEN" install -s "$TV" -n "$(basename "$WGT")" -- "$(dirname "$WGT")"; echo '=== DONE ==='
